description: Find personal trainers listed in the public Trainer Connect directory (most are in Brazil; some are Brazilian trainers abroad), by specialty, name, city or state, and online or in-person. Specialties are written in Portuguese, e.g. "musculação", "emagrecimento", "funcional", "corrida", "hipertrofia". Returns up to 10 trainers with their public profile link. Contact details are never returned: the person talks to the trainer through the profile page.

location.description: City and/or Brazilian state (name or two-letter code), e.g. "Campinas", "SP", "Rio de Janeiro". Leave out for online coaching, which works from anywhere.

modality.description: online for remote coaching, in_person for sessions at a gym or at home.

query.description: Specialty, goal or trainer name, in Portuguese when possible, e.g. "emagrecimento", "musculação", "gestante".

name: find_trainers
title: Find a personal trainer
